classifications.rationale: The President immediately delegates presidential statutory authority to the Secretary of Commerce and permits further redelegation; this is an internal assignment of executive authority, not a dictated substantive outcome.
classifications.evidence: are hereby delegated to the Secretary of Commerce, with power of successive redelegation

classifications.rationale: The President establishes and staffs an internal review board and assigns discretionary and mandatory referral procedures for agency consideration of export-license matters, without determining any license outcome.
classifications.evidence: There is hereby established the Export Control Review Board

classifications.rationale: The Board must review referred matters and recommend action to the Secretary of Commerce; the segment itself neither decides a license nor requires a specified legal result.
classifications.evidence: shall make recommendations thereon to the Secretary of Commerce

classifications.rationale: The segment preserves presidential authority to issue future rules or directives and requires administrative reporting, but does not prescribe any particular future legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Commerce shall from time to time report to the President

classifications.rationale: The President presently supersedes existing export-control provisions while directly continuing outstanding delegations, rules, orders, and licenses in force, producing immediate legal effect rather than merely directing later agency action.
classifications.evidence: All provisions relating to export control that are contained in the following and are now effective are hereby superseded
